purpose: What produced this corpus. Every meta.json carries nodeAppCommit + oracleDigest + contractBundleDigest; the full block lives here. A rebuild that changes an expected.json without changing any field below is a genuine non-determinism and must be investigated, not re-recorded.

contractBundle.note: The frozen progression contract every case's contractStatus is judged against. A re-vendoring changes this digest; a classification that changes without it is a harness defect.

sourcePinning.note: nodeAppCommit + packageLockSha256 identify the transform under test; oracleDigest identifies the harness; contractBundle.digest identifies the schemas the outputs were classified against. A regeneration that changes any expected.json without changing one of these is a genuine non-determinism and must be investigated, not re-recorded.

timezone.probe: TZ=Asia/Tokyo CR_ORACLE_NO_TZ_PIN=1 node oracle/build-corpus.js — the flag is not optional; without it the pin overwrites the outer TZ and the run proves only that the pin works.

outputAxis.authority: the vendored, frozen progression contract in service-cp-crime-court-register/src/main/resources/contracts/progression/
outputAxis.note: IN_CONTRACT means the document the legacy produced satisfies the frozen add-court-register contract, so the port must reproduce it under golden equality. SCHEMA_INVALID means progression answers 400 and the legacy swallows it (defect C1): the port must NOT reproduce the document but reach a classified, dead-lettered contract failure naming the recorded violation. NO_DOCUMENT means the legacy produced nothing, and observed.noDocumentReason carries the obligation instead.

inputAxis.authority: the published hearing model in cpp-platform-core-domain and the event schema public.hearing-resulted.json
inputAxis.note: IN_CONTRACT means the producer can send the payload, so whatever the legacy did with it is a parity obligation. SCHEMA_INVALID and PRODUCER_IMPLAUSIBLE mean it cannot: the recording is robustness evidence, and the port dead-letters as a message-contract violation. A case is a FULL parity obligation only when both axes say so.

operatorScope.note: Which operators ran on which base, and therefore where the corpus deliberately does not look. See OPERATOR_SCOPE in oracle/build-corpus.js for the reasoning.

subscriptionSharing.note: Cases that did not change the reference-data body carry params.subscriptionsFixture naming a file under recorded/subscriptions/ rather than a per-case copy. Cases that did carry params.subscriptionsInline: true and their own inputs/subscriptions.json. Cases with params.subscriptionsAbsent: true made the reference-data call fail and have no body at all.

baseFixtureCaveat: The six base hearings are AUTHORED payloads, copied byte-identical from the port repo's src/test/resources/fixtures/base/. They are not captured production data and they are not legacy Jest fixtures: the legacy has no court-register fixture carrying a complete court centre, a surviving youth defendant, group proceedings, an adult ahead of a youth, a non-prosecuting-authority application or an address-less child. All six share one spine — $DF/OutboundCourtRegister/.../YouthDefendant/test/hearing-resulted.json with a complete court centre, ISO ordered dates and one ungatherable defendant-level result removed. A variant's inputContract classifies THE MUTATION, not the base it is applied to.
subscriptionSchemaCaveat: cpp-context-reference-data/referencedata-query/referencedata-query-api/src/raml/json/schema/referencedata.query.get-now-subscriptions.json is internally inconsistent (additionalProperties:false alongside required entries that are not declared as properties); classifications use only its unambiguous parts.
